title: Energizing Spicy Jamaican Pappardelle Pasta
description: A spicy and energizing Jamaican dish featuring pappardelle pasta, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is a brine-dry and Buddhist-temple-friendly option served in a tagliere vessel.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and chopped scotch bonnet peppers to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the jamaican jerk seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Drain the cooked pappardelle pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the onion and pepper mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a tagliere vessel and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro.
